create.firstGuideHint: The guide the universe opens on the first time: one of the sidecars picked above.
create.withProjectHint: A universe's objects live in the project it serves: a new folder is created and attached, and it opens with its project, its inbox and its planning.
create.title: Create universe
create.displayNameHint: Shown in the IconRibbon flyout and welcome cards. The internal id is derived from this.
create.folderHint: The universe is created at <folder>/.katyoti/. Default: {{path}}

errors.noAlnum: Display name must contain at least one alphanumeric character
errors.reserved: Reserved name "{{name}}" — pick a different display name
errors.exists: Universe with id "{{id}}" already exists — pick a different display name

sidecars.noneOnPath: No ktw-* binaries found on PATH. Install sidecars first or run
sidecars.noneSelectedHint: You can create the universe without any sidecars and add them later.

solution.noSolutions: No solutions offered by your marketplaces. A publisher freezes a working universe into one with
solution.label: Solution
solution.description: A fixed version of a working installation — its sidecars, config-sets, project template, vaults and documents, with no secrets.
solution.noKeys: {{name}} declares no keys — nothing to collect.
solution.noConfigSet: This solution pins no config-set — nothing to collect.
solution.blankAllowed: Every key not marked optional needs a value — typed here, already set, or from a keys file. A blank field keeps the current value.
solution.keysFileHint: A sealed file made by `katyoti keys export`: its keys are written into the new universe first.
solution.universeNameHint: The universe the solution goes into — an existing one by its name, or a new one.
solution.vaults: Its vaults — each opened with its password

picker.welcomeBody: Universes are isolated working contexts — each has its own sidecars, configuration, skills, and data. Create your first one to get started.
picker.title: Pick a universe
picker.subtitle: Each universe is a separate working context. Click a card to enter, or create a new one.

edit.title: Edit universe
edit.slugHint: Read-only — renaming would orphan the data dir
edit.sidecarsHint: The sidecars this universe activates. Membership changes in Marketplace › Sidecars (install, wire, unwire).
edit.manageNeedsOpen: Open this universe first: Marketplace acts on the universe on screen

solution.label: Solution
solution.hint: The solution whose install made this universe - changed by the solution's update
solution.none: This universe belongs to no solution: give it one installed on this machine, so a project whose type needs that solution opens here.
solution.pickHint: <solution> or <solution>@<version> - a name alone takes its installed version

delete.title: Delete universe
delete.protectedBody: The admin universe cannot be deleted — it ships the universe-management tooling and is auto-recreated on every boot.
delete.archiveBodyMiddle: will be moved to its parent's
delete.archiveBodyAfter: directory and removed from the registry. Sessions and data are preserved on disk for recovery; the universe will no longer appear in the IconRibbon.

errors.stopFailed: could not stop the universe before deleting it: {{error}}

projects.intro: Folders that borrow this universe's config and sidecars instead of carrying their own.
projects.empty: No projects attached. A project keeps its own files but uses this universe's configuration — useful when several repos share one setup.
projects.detachHint: Detach — the folder keeps its files and reverts to self-contained
projects.notServed: Recorded, but the universe does not serve it yet: {{reason}}
projects.pickerUnavailable: folder picker unavailable — attach from a terminal with `{{command}}`
projects.newProjectHint: A new project folder in your projects folder, named after the project, attached to this universe.
projects.name: Project name

refused.invalid-name: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes only, like a universe name.
refused.registered: A project with this name already exists. Choose another name.
refused.folder-exists: A folder with this name is already in your projects folder. Choose another name, or attach that folder.
refused.inside-installation: Your projects folder is inside the installation: choose a projects folder outside it first.
